provenance: Hand-written from the /detail field names and examples in Parallel-7/flashforge-api-docs (docs commit f080a1110318a1818461800acb84d89049509761, wiki commit 199ecead9585d3bee16f3e8502afe0f63b6b6b3b, HTTP-REST-API.md, Adventurer-5M-Series.md, State-Machines.md, endpoints_5m_3.2.7.yaml / endpoints_ad5x_1.2.1.yaml). Serial/check code/MAC/IP/registration codes are obviously fake. Not a capture from a real printer. TCP texts are hand-written from Parallel-7 wiki TCP-Protocol.md / State-Machines.md examples (wiki commit 199ecead9585d3bee16f3e8502afe0f63b6b6b3b). No captured traffic from a real FlashForge printer exists in this repository; the captured/ directory may only receive real captures that carry model, firmware and capture-method metadata.

notes.pid: Firmware reports pid as a hex string ('0023'); the 5M YAML types it integer. Fixtures use the hex-string form.
notes.unconfirmed: Real 5M / 5M Pro / AD5X wire traffic, TCP M115 Machine Type for AD5X, and every write path.
